program_solutions:
(rule! (lambda (g)
         (let* ((h (rows g))
                (w (cols g)))
           (let* ((objs (sort-by (objects g 0) obj-c1))
                  (n (length objs)))
             (reduce (lambda (acc i)
                       (let* ((obj (nth objs i))
                              (color (if (= (mod (- n i) 2) 1) 8 2)))
                         (paint-cells acc (obj-cells obj) color)))
                     g
                     (range 0 n))))))
